steps.text: Sketch on XZ: a 26 mm arch, its feet 3 mm below XY where the plate will be.
Select the sketch in the tree, click Form. Pipe radius 6 mm, then Pipe: a tube along the sketch.
Mirror X keeps the halves the same. Soft radius 22 mm: nearby points follow a move, fading out.
Click the top of the arch, drag the Z arrow up 5 mm: a palm swell.
Display: Smooth. Name it and Finish.
Sketch an 80 x 30 mm rectangle on XY, extrude it 6 mm up, joined to the grip: one solid.
Fillet the four plate corners, 5 mm.
Offset plane 6 mm up (the plate top), four 5 mm circles on it, extrude-cut through: mounting holes.
Left-drag up to orbit underneath: the holes go through. Back over the top, Display Mode: Zebra.
